images.title: A bus information board
images.purpose: Show how a table on an information board is read: each row is one bus, each column one fact, and the highest and lowest values stand out.
images.composition: A travel information board with a table of three buses, their distances and the years they were bought, the biggest and smallest distances shaded.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A bus information board with a table of three buses (practice values). THE BOARD is a rounded rectangle x 150 to 1306, y 60 to 650, filled dark #1F2937 and outlined dark #2B2B2B 4 px, on two posts (rectangles filled construction grey #6B7280, x 290 to 320 and x 1136 to 1166, y 650 to 740). The words Bus information in white bold sans-serif (56 px) are centred at x 728, y 120 on the board. THE TABLE is x 200 to 1256 (1056 px wide) with 3 columns each 352 px wide (x 200 to 552, 552 to 904 and 904 to 1256) and 4 rows: a header row y 170 to 260 filled teal #0072B2 and three body rows y 260 to 370, 370 to 480 and 480 to 590 filled white, all outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px with thin grey #6B7280 lines (2 px). The header texts in white bold sans-serif (40 px), one per column: Bus, Distance in km, Year bought. The body cells in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (72 px), left to right, row by row: row 1: A, 4,215, 2015; row 2: B, 6,380, 2018; row 3: C, 5,094, 2021. The distance cell of row 2 (6,380) is filled amber #E69F00 and the distance cell of row 1 (4,215) is filled pale teal #CFE5F2. Under the board, centred at x 728, y 780, the text practice values in construction grey #6B7280 bold sans-serif (40 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the real mountain table or the certificate table of the book
numbers other than the listed ones
images.takeaway: Read the row and the column, compare to find the highest and the lowest, and subtract to find a difference.
images.description: An information board with a table of buses A, B and C, distances 4,215, 6,380 and 5,094 km, and the years 2015, 2018 and 2021.
images.context: Concept image for Reading a Table: Highest, Difference, Short or Extra, Section A, using the example's own numbers (practice values). The book's own tables stay on the question cards and in the Table Explorer.
images.teaching_notes: Point at a row and then at a column. The slip to watch: comparing numbers from different columns.

images.title: Printed against came
images.purpose: Show how comparing two numbers tells how many are short or extra, using bars and a bracket for the difference.
images.composition: Two pairs of bars, printed against came, with the difference bracketed and labelled short in the first pair and extra in the second.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two pairs of bars comparing tickets printed with people who came; the bars are not to scale. The words Printed and Came in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (36 px), right-aligned at x 230, label the bars. PAIR 1: a teal #0072B2 bar x 250 to 1050, y 150 to 230 holding 12,450 in white bold (48 px); an amber #E69F00 bar x 250 to 1130, y 250 to 330 holding 12,615 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px); a bracket (dark #2B2B2B 4 px, opening upwards) under the extra part of the amber bar, x 1050 to 1130, y 340 to 360, with the label 165 short in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) centred at x 1290, y 350. PAIR 2: a teal bar x 250 to 1130, y 470 to 550 holding 9,830 in white bold (48 px); an amber bar x 250 to 1050, y 570 to 650 holding 9,415 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px); a bracket (dark 4 px, opening upwards) under the extra part of the teal bar, x 1050 to 1130, y 560 to 580, with the label 415 extra in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) centred at x 1290, y 570. At the bottom left, x 230, y 770, the small caption practice values in construction grey #6B7280 bold sans-serif (32 px), and at the bottom right, x 1350, y 770, the words not to scale in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (32 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a bracket on the wrong bar
images.takeaway: If fewer were printed than came, the difference is how many are short; if more, how many are extra.
images.description: Bars of 12,450 printed and 12,615 came with 165 short, and 9,830 printed and 9,415 came with 415 extra.
images.context: Concept image for Reading a Table: Highest, Difference, Short or Extra, Section B, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Compare the bars before reading the numbers. The slip to watch: adding instead of subtracting.

image_decisions.why: One video, two sections, one picture each: the information board with its table is the object the student must learn to read in Section A, and the bracketed difference between the bars is the mathematics of Section B.
